name: smwmusic-touhou-bunkachou-shoot-the-bullet-retrospective-kyoto
title: Touhou Bunkachou ~ Shoot the Bullet - Retrospective Kyoto
description:
The somberish fourth photo theme from the 9.5th Touhou game, Shoot the Bullet.

The song has a generally solemn vibe to it, kind of like "it's the end of game, you know what to expect", but also picks up in the second half. I guess you could think of it truly like a retrospective, with it being bittersweet, but never painful.

Update: fixed an issue with channel #5's legato/pitch not resetting properly on loop.
